difficulty_reason: For an affine open V ⊂ X over an affine open U ⊂ S, write V = lim V_i with V_i of finite presentation over U; limit preservation factors V -> X through some V_i, and after increasing i the factorization lands in V (inverse images of V stabilize by the descend-opens lemma); the identity of V then factors through some V_i over U, which forces V -> U to be of finite presentation - the algebraic core being that an identity factoring through a finitely presented algebra is finitely presented.
